_note: ALL SYNTHETIC. Keys, tokens and IDs are invented lookalikes (AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE is AWS's published docs example). Card numbers are public test numbers or deliberately Luhn-invalid. Names and emails are invented. Never put real data here.
_expect: PASSWORD = password / PIN / OTP-style credential. API_KEY = API key, access token, JWT, private key, URL with password. CARD = payment card number. OTHER_PII = email / government ID. none = should not warn.
_design: Email, PH mobile numbers and bank account numbers get a SOFT warning (medium severity, 'Intended?', category OTHER_PII): small businesses share them on purpose to get paid. SSH PUBLIC keys are meant to be shared and stay 'none'; SSH PRIVATE keys are API_KEY. Role talk (admin, staff, viewer) without a secret is 'none'.
_team: Cases tagged team-case-N come from the team's manual (section 8). Case 3 ('4532 1234 5678 9012') fails the Luhn checksum, so no Luhn-based detector can flag it; '4532 0151 1283 0366' is a Luhn-valid replacement.
